description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml for converting configuration schema interchange data into XML format, including methods for building XML documents from schema components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml
classes.description: A class extending XMLWriter to generate XML documentation from HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange data.

methods.name: writeHTMLDiv
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML content using HTMLPurifier and writes it inside a div element.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a variable as a string, returning 'array()' for empty arrays.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an XML document from the interchange object, setting up the document structure.

methods.name: buildNamespace
methods.description: Builds XML elements for a namespace, including description and directives.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Builds XML elements for a directive, including constraints, aliases, description, and deprecation info.
